name: DOC_RAG_KRX_BENCHMARK_FILTERED
description: A filtered dataset hosted on Hugging Face designed to evaluate retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems on document-grounded tasks. It measures how well models can retrieve relevant passages and generate factually correct answers given those documents. The dataset is focused on document-level QA/response generation in a filtered (domain-specific) corpus.
reputation: Niche community dataset on Hugging Face with limited widespread adoption outside its uploader/community.
